takeaways: Interview algorithm topics are grouped into 10 categories, from arrays and strings to graphs and bit manipulation.
Each category lists specific classic problems, such as Trapping Rain Water, Edit Distance, and Dijkstra's algorithm.
The page links to deeper topic guides and to related lists of top 50 coding problems per data structure.
summary.summary: This GeeksforGeeks article is a checklist of algorithm problems commonly asked in tech interviews. It groups roughly 100 problems into 10 categories: arrays, strings, sorting, searching, recursion/backtracking, greedy, trees, dynamic programming, graphs, and bit manipulation. Each category gives short problem titles with links to topic guides and to related top-50 problem lists. The page itself contains no code or explanations, so it works best as a study index rather than a tutorial.
